text: Survey crews at the Hadrow Flats site in East Merrow confirmed the presence of lithium brine, according to a preliminary assessment released Monday by the Bracken County Development Office. The finding came after eight weeks of drilling and sampling across the shallow basin, where officials said salinity and conductivity readings pointed to a commercially significant deposit. County geologist Mara Ellison said the team recovered brine from three test wells and is now mapping the reserve’s extent. “This is an encouraging result for the region and for local jobs,” Ellison said. The county expects to complete a fuller resource estimate by early spring, with environmental review and access planning to follow if the project advances.
